findings.trigger: First pair native extraction request differs on goal
findings.expected: Mark pair invalid and stop after second trial
findings.rootCause: Pair comparisons are informational only in save(); no execution/validity gate consumes mismatches.

findings.expected: Persist terminal audit failure and preservation failure status before returning/throwing
findings.actual: Throws FROZEN_SOURCE_CHANGED; saved manifest status RUNNING and preservationAfter false
findings.rootCause: No outer catch assigns fatal status; finally runs preserve before save, so the same rejection prevents final save.
